title: AI Slop Cleanup Subagent Prompt Pack

source.origin_note: Instagram carousel screenshots captured from @thewizeai. Local folder: /Users/dhyana/Desktop/untitled folder.

before_agent_run: record source_artifact and prompt_hash in the work packet
run impact analysis before edits to any target symbol
after_agent_run: never apply deletion or consolidation without human review

lanes.title: Subagent 1: Deduplication
lanes.transcript: Scan the entire codebase for repeated logic, copy pasted functions, and redundant abstractions. Consolidate where it reduces complexity without obscuring intent. Implement DRY only where it genuinely simplifies. Do not merge code that merely looks similar but serves different purposes.
lanes.objective: Find true duplication while preserving intentionally separate domain behavior.
allowed_actions: propose consolidation when call sites share behavior and contract
extract shared helpers only when intent remains clearer
document intentionally duplicated patterns
forbidden_actions: do not auto-merge code based on surface similarity
do not merge domain-specific functions that serve different purposes
do not reduce readability to satisfy DRY

lanes.title: Subagent 2: Type Consolidation
lanes.transcript: Find all type definitions scattered across files. Consolidate any that should be shared where duplication causes drift or inconsistency. Check for types defined in multiple places that have quietly gone out of sync. Merge into a single source of truth.
lanes.objective: Move duplicated type contracts toward canonical ownership without breaking boundaries.
allowed_actions: identify duplicate or drifting models
propose canonical type owner
migrate call sites in bounded batches
forbidden_actions: do not auto-merge types across bounded contexts
do not create a new shared type without proving at least two real users
do not weaken types to make consolidation pass

lanes.title: Subagent 3: Dead Code Removal
lanes.transcript: Use tools like knip to find all unused exports, unreferenced functions, and orphaned files. Verify MANUALLY before removing. Check for dynamic imports, config references, framework conventions, and code generation that static analysis misses. Remove only what is CONFIRMED dead.
lanes.objective: Find dead code candidates and promote only confirmed deletions.
allowed_actions: open deletion candidates as reviewed proposals
add whitelist entries for intentional dynamic entry points
remove confirmed dead code only after impact evidence
forbidden_actions: do not auto-delete any code from static analysis alone
do not delete framework or dynamic entry points without runtime evidence
do not treat low coverage as proof of dead code

lanes.title: Subagent 4: Circular Dependencies
lanes.transcript: Use tools like madge to map the full dependency graph. Identify every circular import and prioritize the ones that affect maintainability, testability, or correctness. Untangle by extracting shared logic into neutral modules. Do not introduce new abstractions just to break a cycle.
lanes.objective: Prioritize harmful cycles and fix them with neutral ownership, not abstraction churn.
allowed_actions: rank cycles by runtime and test impact
extract neutral modules when ownership is clear
document accepted cycles when risk is lower than churn
forbidden_actions: do not auto-refactor cycles without impact analysis
do not introduce abstraction layers solely to appease the graph
do not move code across architecture boundaries without contract review

lanes.title: Subagent 5: Type Strengthening
lanes.transcript: Find every instance of any, unknown, and other weak types the AI left as placeholders. Research what the real types should be by inspecting the codebase, related packages, and actual runtime usage. Replace with STRONG types. Run type checks after every batch. Preserve legitimate boundary types where unknown is correct.
lanes.objective: Replace placeholder weak types with evidence-backed strong types while preserving valid boundaries.
allowed_actions: strengthen internal types after call-site inspection
preserve unknown at valid external boundaries
split changes into small type-checking batches
forbidden_actions: do not auto-replace unknown at public or plugin boundaries
do not use casts to silence real uncertainty
do not weaken runtime validation to satisfy static typing

lanes.title: Subagent 6: Error Handling Cleanup
lanes.transcript: Find all try/catch blocks and equivalent defensive patterns. Remove any that are silently swallowing errors, hiding failures, or falling back to defaults that mask real problems. Keep error handling that serves a REAL boundary: recovery, logging, cleanup, or user facing error reporting. No error hiding. No silent fallbacks.
lanes.objective: Turn silent failure into explicit recovery, logging, escalation, or verified fallback behavior.
allowed_actions: replace broad silent catches with logged or typed handling
keep cleanup and boundary recovery paths
add tests for fallback behavior
forbidden_actions: do not auto-remove exception handling at IO or process boundaries
do not replace silent pass with noisy failure without caller review
do not hide errors behind defaults

lanes.title: Subagent 7: Deprecated Code And AI Slop
lanes.transcript: Find legacy, deprecated, and fallback code paths. Remove only what is CLEARLY obsolete and not required for compatibility or active users. Then find every AI artifact: stubs, placeholder logic, comments that narrate edit history instead of explaining intent. Remove all of it. If a comment is worth keeping, rewrite it so a NEW engineer understands why the code exists.
lanes.objective: Separate compatibility code from obsolete fallback and placeholder artifacts.
allowed_actions: propose obsolete paths with compatibility evidence
rewrite narrative comments into intent comments
remove placeholder logic only with tests or runtime proof
forbidden_actions: do not auto-delete compatibility paths
do not remove fallback behavior without active-user evidence
do not delete comments that encode non-obvious intent
